name: tencent/hy4-preview
description: Hy4 preview is Tencent Hunyuan's open-source preview of its Hy4 generation, a mixture-of-experts language model with 770B total and 49B active parameters and a context window exceeding 1M tokens. Tencent built it for real-world productivity: long-context software development and front-end work, office and financial analysis, game prototyping and scientific research. Tencent follows a preview-first approach, with official Hy4 releases to come after this model.
